articleTitle: Predicting the Veracity of News Articles Using Multimodal Embeddings and NLP-Based Features
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The prevalence of false news in today's culture has brought to light the necessity for automated systems that can recognize and categorize news stories according to their validity with accuracy. The validity of news items is predicted using multimodal embeddings and characteristics based on natural language processing (NLP) in this work. In this method, the textual and visual content of news articles are jointly modeled using multimodal embeddings, and NLP-based features like sentiment, readability, and subjectivity are extracted. A machine learning model is then trained using these features to categorize news articles as true or false. The performance of the suggested method has been assessed against a number of cutting-edge algorithms for the identification of false news using a huge dataset of news items. The experimental findings demonstrate the efficacy of multimodal embeddings and NLP-based features by showing that it produces greater accuracy and F1 scores in comparison to other techniques. The suggested method offers a potential technique for the automatic identification and categorization of news stories based on their truthfulness, which might have significant effects on the fight against the spread of false information in modern society.

articleTitle: A Framework for Smart & Secure Vehicle Intelligent Life Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In today's world, vehicle safety has become one of the most concerns for private. Nowadays, existing alarm systems of vehicles can be easily replaced as the necessary tools are equally available. While traveling safety is everyone's primary concern. This analysis explains the model of an efficient data model that can monitor and secure the condition of the vehicle / car. The use of IoT for tracking and monitoring is the components. Internet of Things (IoT) is significant for observing the vehicles, medical treatment and manufacturing approaches. By the uninterrupted growth of Internet of Things, many “things” are capable. In this framework, a new IoT based framework depended on Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) and System on Chip (SoC) that gives unified access for IoT is low as well as high-speed devices with extensibility and configurability. Hence, this model performs better accuracy and security.

articleTitle: ChatGuard: A Profanity Classification Approach for Safer Online Conversations
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: With every passing day, our world becomes more and more technology driven. Kids are now being introduced to a variety of devices and exposed to the internet from a very young age. The internet is full of information, good or bad. And it has become fundamental for parents to exercise some control and censorship over not only the content that their kids consume but also their interactions over the internet. The aim of this project has been to build to tool that will help in doing just that. It allows to closely monitor the language so that any use of obscene or offensive words can be detected. Even the simple knowledge of what words has been used, can aid parents in initiating a conversation to help their kids understand why certain language is inappropriate or even wrong to guide them as they unlearn any such unhealthy habits and language patterns. The program essentially analyses the text we provide to it and detect profanity or offensive terms. It has been trained against a large dataset and uses machine learning methods to process text and find out if there are any such terms in it.

articleTitle: Adoption of Industry 4.0 Technologies for Performance Management
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The fourth industrial revolution (Industry 4.0) continues to evolve, revolutionize, and impact various aspects of contemporary organizations, and one such paradigm shift is pertinent to performance management. Innovative advancements in emerging and advanced Industry 4.0 technologies, such as artificial intelligence (AI), internet-of-things (IoT), cloud computing, machine learning (ML), digital twin, big data analytics, automation, and several others are reshaping the performance management domain in myriad ways. This study delves into the adoption of Industry 4.0 technologies that influence how organizations measure, evaluate, and augment employee performance. Digital tools assist in monitoring remote performance, and AI-driven algorithms offer predictive analytics. Comprehensively, these foster agility, adaptability, and alignment, thus providing personalized insights, continuous feedback, and performance trends. While it enhances objectivity and efficiency, there are also critical challenges relating to data privacy and ethical considerations. Study findings emphasize the transformative potential that Industry 4.0 has in transforming performance management parameters toward workforce empowerment and heightened levels of engagement and productivity.

articleTitle: A CNN Based Approach for Depression Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Since the emergence of large information, recognising facial expressions (FER) has become an important topic in deep learning. Human psychological functioning is symbolised by the human symbol. Expressions on the face can disclose a great deal about human beings. At this point, melancholy had reached the status of a serious psychological illness. Recognising melancholy individuals is essential. We proposed a technique using CNN, Open CV, and a Haar Cascades Classification for detecting melancholy. The Haas Cascade Classifier is a form of AI where the machines learn by themselves detects faces. The proposed combination method employs layers of convolution. In addition, there are no accessible data sets that record genuine emotions of the melancholy visage and can be utilised for diagnosing melancholy. Consequently, we compiled a 5000-person Depressive and Not Depressive (DND) dataset. The proposed combination method employs convolution layers. In addition, there are no publicly accessible data sets that record the natural emotions of the melancholy visage and can be utilised for diagnosing depression.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Perspectives on Surface Wettability: LSTM Predictions for Water Droplet Contact Angles
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Surface wettability is the ability of a liquid to adhere to a solid surface, determined by the interaction between the liquid and the solid, primarily influenced by the liquid's surface tension and the solid's properties. The surface wettability can distinguish the surfaces into three categories, hydrophilic, hydrophobic, and superhydrophobic. Surface wettability plays various important roles in medical implants, drug delivery systems, and tissue engineering. It also plays an important role in microfluidics, textiles, surface coating materials, and solar panels. The conventional approaches to finding surface wettabilities using experiments may be costly and time-consuming. Hence, this work integrates the pseudo-potential lattice Boltzmann method and deep learning approach for analyzing and predicting surface wettability using solid-fluid interaction parameters (Gads). First, we develop an LBM model for collecting surface wettability data with various parameters. We consider the solid-fluid interaction parameter and droplet radius for analyzing the wettability. We then develop deep learning models using LSTM and do various experiments to find the best models in terms of R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> score and Mean-Squared Error (MSE) for the performance evaluation.

articleTitle: Enhancing Breast Cancer Diagnosis with Deep Learning in Histopathology Images
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The form of cancer that is most common in women is Breast Cancer (BC), with more than 1 in 10 new cases diagnosed each year. BC is one of the primary and most prevalent factors in cancer-related deaths in women. By enabling the patient to get appropriate medication, early detection of BC can save the lives of cancer patients. Deep learning algorithms are presently the topic of promising research for their early detection. Today, to use a proposed algorithm in medical image analysis the model must be highly accurate. To categorize BC histopathological images, this study compares the performance of various deep learning algorithms from previous studies. The study identifies the most accurate binary classification models for the histopathology image databases of breast cancer. The authors also implement and assess the performance of EfficientNetV2 models, a cutting-edge deep learning architecture, in the categorization of breast cancer histopathological images for binary classifications in addition to contrasting various deep learning algorithms. Future possibilities in this area of research are also discussed.

articleTitle: IOT Based Air Pollution Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Air pollution influences both our everyday routines and our lifestyle. Both the ecosystem and the quality of life throughout the world are in danger. Checking the air quality is obviously necessary because there have been more industrial operations in recent years. People need to be conscious of how much their behavior affects the air quality. In this project, a system for tracking air pollution is suggested. The system was developed using the Arduino microcontroller. It is possible to monitor and keep an eye on the air pollution levels in real time thanks to the important help of the Air Pollution Monitoring System. The air quality needs to be stabilized and maintained under control for the sake of everyone's safety and for a better, safer future. Mild allergic reactions and a variety of medical disorders that call for screening are among the negative effects of pollution. Different sensors built within the apparatus monitor factors that contribute to pollution. Real-time monitoring of the air pollution levels is feasible with the help of the Monitoring System developed for checking air pollution levels. Air quality needs to be balanced and maintained under control for the benefit of everyone and for a better, safer future. Many medical issues that need monitoring and moderate allergic reactions are among pollution's negative impacts.

articleTitle: AI in Education-A Transformative Force
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) holds the potential to profoundly transform education, offering personalized learning experiences and improving student engagement and outcomes. AI's applications encompass adaptive learning, intelligent tutoring, data-driven insights, administrative automation, content generation, language support, accessibility, and predictive analytics. Nonetheless, ethical concerns, such as data privacy and algorithmic fairness, must be carefully addressed in the responsible implementation of AI. As AI continues to advance, it promises to shape a more dynamic and equitable educational landscape.

articleTitle: Correlation Between Operation of Single and Dual Axis Solar Tracker System
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: A handsome amount of money is being invested in and for development of renewable energy sources for solar and wind power plants. The elevation of the sun fluctuates as change in weather is considered, travelling from north to south in addition to its daily movement from east to west. The production from solar energy majorly depends on illumination, rainfalls, water cycles, and weather patterns. This paper compares solar panels with 1-axis and 2-axis tracking systems using an experimental design. The readings were taken for every half an hour. Along with the architectural and operational aspects of the tracking systems, the key characteristics of both 1-axis and 2-axis tracking systems are also covered. The purpose of this work is to use an experimental methodology to compare the efficiency of solar panels with 1-axis and 2-axis tracking systems. In order to assess the effect of various tracking systems on solar energy production, hourly data were acquired. The research also compares and contrasts 1-axis and 2-axis tracking systems, focusing on their distinctive architectural and operational features. Both single- and dual-axis tracking systems for solar panels were found to increase energy output compared to stationary solar panels. Differences between the two tracking methods were clearly seen in the data. Single-axis trackers, which primarily monitor the sun's east-west motion, have been shown to operate well under cloudless skies. However, dual-axis trackers, which follow the sun's east-west and north-south motions, performed better in a wider variety of climates.

articleTitle: A Pre-trained MobileNetV2 Model for Oral Cancer Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In emerging economies and regions with low to middle incomes, oral cancer has emerged as one of the prevalent malignant tumours and a highly critical medical condition. Timely detection and appropriate treatment can often avert fatality for the majority of cancer cases. Conversely, delayed diagnosis and delayed treatment initiation can pose life-threatening risks. Hence, early identification of oral cancer plays a pivotal role in saving lives. Early detection coupled with effective treatment of oral cancer can substantially lower the mortality rate associated with the disease. Future advancements in cancer detection and diagnosis could witness a transformative impact through the integration of developments in biomedical optics and deep learning techniques. In the proposed work, oral cancer prediction has been derived by harnessing data from Kaggle and utilizing a Convolutional Neural Network-based pre-trained MobileNetV2 model. This model has been fine-tuned with different batch sizes and epoch values. Notably, employing a batch size of 64 and training for 5 epochs yielded an accuracy of 66.80% and a loss of 0.6131. However, by modifying the batch size to 128 and epoch count to 10, the accuracy improved while the loss diminished. The values of accuracy and loss have been identified as 78.12% and 0.5138, respectively. Further, in future, to achieve a better performance outcome, the model can be implemented by increasing the epoch values.

articleTitle: Classification of Respiratory Disorders Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Global health is still being significantly impacted by the recent pandemic, coronavirus-2019 (COVID-19), quick testing, effective diagnosis, and treatment. The early detection of COVID-19 is crucial for effective treatment and avoiding strain on the healthcare system because it can cause severe pneumonia. In addition to COVID-19, other causes of pneumonia and tuberculosis (TB) present additional challenges for the medical system. According to Bernadeta Dadonaite and Max Roser, “2.5 million people died from pneumonia in 2019,” according to their article on Our World in Data, which was first published in November 2019. It is the leading cause of minor's death, accounting for nearly a third of all victims. The principal imaging modalities for identifying respiratory disorders are chest X-rays (CXR) and computed tomography (CT) scans. Despite being the most advanced standard, CT scans are more expensive, take longer, and expose the patient to a modest but considerable dosage of radiation. As a result, CXR has become increasingly often used as a first-line inquiry. In recent years, it has become clear that Computer Aided Designs (CAD) has flourished in the medical sector, particularly in the use of deep learning for the early detection of lung nodules, breast cancer, and other conditions using mammography. When applying Deep Learning (DL) techniques to medical images, expressive features are crucial. Most earlier algorithms that created CAD systems by analyzing images used hand-crafted features as a result. So hence, this study proposes a model to classify pneumonia based on the area of infection in lungs. This experimental work includes classification of pneumonia, covid pneumonia and TB pneumonia using Chest X-Rays Images.

articleTitle: Digital Resilience: A Review of Cutting-Edge Approaches to Cyberbullying Detection in the Social Media Landscape
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Cyberbullying, characterized as a form of harmful online conduct, involves an ongoing pattern where a bully sends a series of abusive messages to a victim with the intention of causing harm over a period. Impropriety involving blackmailing, threatening, harassment, abusing, impersonating, mocking, etc. has become a widespread problem on social media platforms. To address this persistent issue, it's vital to develop a mechanism that can accurately detect and prevent cyberbullying. In this study, we present a comparison of cutting-edge machine learning and deep learning models that are applicable in detecting bullying instances in social media networks. It also examines the current landscape of advanced techniques and algorithms capable of detecting obscene language. Various neural network architectures, natural language processing techniques, ensemble methods, and hybrid systems are considered. A strong emphasis on the feature engineering process along with feature selection algorithms to select a significant feature based on human-engineered observations are also discussed.

articleTitle: Medical Image Fusion Using Discrete Wavelet Transform: In view of Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Medical image fusion technique plays a major role in various clinical applications by deriving the multi modal information of medical images. This paper describes an approach for wavelet based medical image fusion of Computed Tomography (CT) and Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) images. Both the types of images are decomposed using wavelets. Various wavelet families are explored and nine different combinations of approximation coefficients and detail coefficients of CT and MRI images are used to get the fused image. These generated fused images are obtained from deep learning implementation point of view. After obtaining the results, it is observed that the max-max combination of approximation coefficients and detail coefficients is producing the better result in comparison with other type of combinations.

articleTitle: IoT Based Pothole Detection and Alert System
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The maintenance of roads is crucial for transportation and the economy. Potholes and humps on roads can lead to accidents, vehicle damage, and increased fuel consumption. Therefore, it is important to detect and identify potholes and humps to prevent accidents and reduce damage to vehicles. A simple and effective solution can be implemented to address this problem. Detection of potholes will be done by ultrasonic sensor and the width of the pothole can be determined by the picture taken by the ESP32 Camera Module. This photo along with the exact coordinates will be pushed on the map with the help of GPS module, the whole system will be controlled by Arduino Nano microcontroller, so that the other drivers get an alerted in advance.

articleTitle: Brain Connectivity Using Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The integration of deep learning into the examination of brain connectivity marks a transformative era in understanding neural networks. This article provides a concise overview of the burgeoning field of deep learning in brain connectivity analysis. It defines the concept, explores functional and structural connectivity, outlines practical applications, delves into the algorithms involved, compares traditional methods vs advanced deep learning approaches for brain connectivity and highlights its revolutionary impact in clinical practice. In deep learning, brain connectivity investigates neural links using advanced artificial intelligence. Functional connectivity, powered by deep neural networks, reveals patterns in brain activity linked to cognition, emotion, and decision-making. Structural connectivity, often utilizing graph neural networks, reconstructs intricate neural pathways. This technology shows significant progress in diagnosing conditions like Alzheimer's, schizophrenia, and autism. As it evolves, its clinical importance becomes evident, offering early disease detection, tailored treatments, and a deeper understanding of neurological disorders. Beyond clinical applications, deep learning in brain connectivity opens avenues for advancements in brain-computer interfaces, enhanced rehabilitation therapies, and precise interventions.

articleTitle: Industry 4.0 Enabled Smart Manufacturing: Unleashing the Power of Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: A new era of manufacturing marked by the convergence of digital technology and physical systems has begun as a result of Industry 4.0's development. This revolution's, smart manufacturing, uses cutting-edge technology like artificial intelligence (AI) and blockchain to promote efficiency, openness, and innovation throughout industrial processes. Using systematic literature review method and thematic analysis, this study looks at the investigation on smart manufacturing industry 4.0, Artificial intelligence and blockchain from 2018 to 2022. The objective of the research is to examine the mutually beneficial interaction between Smart industrial, AI, and Blockchain, outlining how their integration is changing industrial techniques. Furthermore, the study aims to identify potential future trends and research avenues in this area along with development of a conceptual model for future research.

articleTitle: Delhi Air Pollution Prediction Based on Weather Conditions Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Air Quality Index is a government metric which is computed using averages of the different pollutants which are present in the air including particulates, nitrogen dioxide, ozone, sulphur dioxide, carbon monoxide. It is a standardized measure used to quantify the air pollution levels caused by vehicles, forest fires, industrial wastes, etc. We will predict the expected Air Quality Index for a given location (Delhi) based on meteorological conditions like Temperature, Wind Speed, Dew Point, Pressure, etc. which will help gauge whether pollution levels are following historical trends or if environmental policies have had an effect. It is also helpful for people with respiratory conditions which inhibit them such that harsh pollution can have an adverse effect on their health, so that they can plan their day in advance using the weather forecast.

articleTitle: An Experimental Investigation of U-Net-Based Deep Learning Segmentation for Histopathology Images
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The work delves into the scrutiny of an optimal combination of optimizer-activation function pairs for the Nuclei Dataset using U-Net architecture. Among 15 combinations, encompassing three Optimizers (Adagard, Adadelta, Adam) and five Activation Functions (Leaky-ReLU, Sigmoid, Tanh, Softmax, ReLU), the study meticulously examines their impact on the Input Layer. The U-Net model, characterized by four contraction and expansion stages, undergoes training on 570 images sourced from the Data Science Bowl. With 25 epochs and integrated callbacks, the training ceases if validation loss remains constant for consecutive epochs. Notably, the Adam optimizer coupled with the ReLU activation function attains the pinnacle with an accuracy nearing 96 percent and minimal loss. Although both Adam and Adagrad optimizers exhibit commendable results, Adam emerges as the superior choice. Regrettably, conclusive results for the Adadelta optimizer remain elusive due to elevated loss and diminished accuracy.

Index Terms: Activation Function Of The Output Layer

articleTitle: Analysis of Military Security Surveillance Applications Using Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks are a type of device that converts any of the physical quantity to an understandable, and observable quantity. Sensors are lightweight and distributed in large numbers to monitor the type of system and environment around them. Wireless Sensor Networks are deployed in many areas like agriculture, military security surveillance, animal husbandry and tracking, smart surroundings and buildings, health sciences of patient monitoring and care, air pressure temperature around us, noise levels, and many others. This paper tells various executions and uses of WSNs with military surveillance and security systems.

articleTitle: Medical Record Management System Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The EHR is a patient's medical history in digital form. Electronic health records allow for record collection, creation, and storage. Electronic health records are sluggish to implement by healthcare practitioners. Our national government recently passed legislation requiring the use of an Electronic Record System. The electronic health record (EHR) will improve clinical recording, healthcare utilisation tracking, quality control, and invoicing. It will also simplify healthcare record management and mobility. Administrative activities, lab systems, computerised physician order entry, radiography systems, clinical documentation, and pharmacy systems are basic parts of electronic health records. Customers save money, increase quality and safety, and improve healthcare efficiency using electronic health records. EHR challenges include pricey software, system security, patient confidentiality, and unknown government regulations. EHR management will benefit from bar coding, speech recognition, and RFID.

articleTitle: SVM Based Detection of Real and Spoofed Faces Based on Handcrafted Features
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Infringement in biometric authentication is one of the crucial concerns in today's scenario. Many of the robust authentication systems fall prey to crude spoofing attacks and their performance had been drastically dropped due to several unseen attacks owing to technological advancements available at no cost. The objective of the proposed work is to design a robust spoof detection system that can sustain even the worst undetectable unseen interference that can fool a state-of-the-art authentication technique. The work comprises four stages and consists of removing artifacts, extracting the optimum features conventionally, reducing the dimensionality of the feature vector and the classification system. The 75:25 percent train: test analysis showed that the selected dimension of the handcrafted features using the Gaussian kernel of the Support Vector Machine was able to produce remarkable results overthe IDIAP dataset. The classification accuracy was 100% for 3488 test images and approximately 99.54% for 6000 test images.

Author Keywords: automatic face cropping and principal component analysis

articleTitle: Small Object Detection in Remote Sensing Images using Modified YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: With advancements in aerospace remote sensing technology, it is now possible to rapidly collect a huge number of high-quality satellite images with high spectral or spatial resolution, and object detection in remote sensing imaging has become one of the hottest topics. Various difficulties to object recognition exist due to the complexity of visual data, such as unanticipated object movements, noise, partial or complete occlusion, variation in the background, lighting variation, and so on. Existing models have various flaws, including overfitting and poor performance in small object detection. As a result, we have proposed a modified YOLOv5 approach to accelerate the detection model's learning process and improve its efficiency.

articleTitle: Visualizing Land Use and Land Cover in the Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Big data is this present period in which we find ourselves. During land use and land covering visualization, the amount of acquired or stored geographical information, particularly supplementary geographical information systems and observational aerial photos, is growing. Additionally, modern distributed computing, deep neural networks, and predictive techniques are currently being created. Although those geographical large data and cutting-edge technological advances in computers offer new prospects for land utilization and land cover diagramming, problems often arise when employing such geographical information. The assessment of investigations and scientific advancements in satellite imaging, artificial intelligence, deep neural networks, including geographical information with land use and land cover modelling until 2020 are summarized in the following paper. We analyzed the advantages, disadvantages, and possible future developments of land use and land cover modelling utilizing geographic information. Regarding better land use and land cover patterning at massive scales, further study must be done.

articleTitle: Advanced Deep Learning-Based Methods for Clinical Assessment of Brain Tumours
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: A central nervous system tumour can result in asymmetrical if it is situated in a region that is affected by the nerves that maintain facial balance. The imbalance is not a symptom of all malignancies in the brain, though. Many tumours might exist in regions which don't influence the proportions of the face or the contour of the forehead. Computerized neural networks are used to analyses scans of brain tissue as well as categories tumours into two categories: benign (not cancerous) or malignant (cancerous) by employing deep learning algorithms. Convolutional Neural Networks (have been employed in the discipline of health care photography for tasks including the categorization of neurological tumours. It is frequently possible to find any present brain tumours by reviewing the individual's magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) results. While confronted with numerous types of neurological tumours as well as an enormous volume of information, this method is laborious and susceptible to mistaken information. The three most common types of brain tumours, glioma, meningioma, and pituitary, were programmed to be detected by deep learning algorithms for the suggested investigation. These algorithms have been optimized employing the Aquila Optimizer (AQO), which at first was employed to earn the preliminary sample subsequent generations along with alterations for the chosen information set, breaking down the results into 70% for the training set and 20% for the set to be evaluated. For the modelling and testing of the brain tumour information set, we employed the AQO optimizer with the VGG-16, VGG19, and Inception-V3 topologies and DenseNet to get the best rate of prediction 97.94 % for the DenseNet algorithm

articleTitle: Self-Supervised Visual Representation Learning Framework for Road Sign Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In the landscape of machine learning, the dominance of supervised learning in crafting specialized models for specific tasks is evident, yet its confinement in terms of broader generalization has underscored the quest for more versatile models capable of acquiring multiple skills without an insurmountable reliance on labelled data. A pivotal avenue toward this goal lies in self-supervised learning (SSL), which promises to instill foundational knowledge and a semblance of common sense into AI systems. This investigation undertakes a comprehensive exploration of diverse SSL strategies, elucidating their inherent constraints on the road sign detection and classification usecase. Through an intricate comparative analysis spotlighting Context Autoencoders (CAE) and MoCoV3 - two prominent state-of-the-art methodologies leveraging masked image modelling and contrastive learning, respectively - we unravel their distinct attributes and limitations. Furthermore, we introduce an innovative end-to-end framework meticulously tailored for self-supervised road sign classification. Our roadmap encompasses the infusion of domain-specific expertise in road signs into this framework, followed by rigorous benchmarking against state-of-the-art SSL models across diverse road sign datasets, employing a spectrum of evaluation metrics. This study emerges as a stepping stone, propelling AI closer to comprehesive intelligence by harnessing the potency of self-supervised paradigms.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In recent years, new technologies have helped avoid numerous diseases when diagnosed early. Health is a popular research topic. Developing a user-friendly platform that can help end-users get nearly accurate predictions so they can take timely actions to prevent or manage medical situations by consulting a clinical expert and living a healthy lifestyle can help prevent disease and death graphs from growing faster. Thus, a user-friendly platform is created using different machine learning methods to make accurate predictions based on specified characteristics and deliver them to the user. For diabetes and cardiovascular disease prediction, five machine learning models-LR, DT, KNN, SVM, and Perceptron-are used.

articleTitle: A Review on Optimizing Endodontic Procedures: Integrating AI and Single- File Systems for Enhanced Efficiency and Precision
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Formerly, in endodontics those same conventional stainless-steel files which comes under the category of hand files were used for disinfection, cleaning along with shaping of the canal within the tooth root. The biological and mechanical goals of endodontic treatment cannot be met without effective shaping as well as cleaning of root canal system. Goal is to eliminate as much organic material from root canal system as feasible. Single file systems are classified basically into two groups: continuous rotating and reciprocating files. Various types of files system comes under the single file system that are waveone, F360, Tfile, SAF, one shape and reciproc file system. To avoid torsional breakage, the single file technique (wave one and reciproc) uses repeating movement with CW and CCW cutting angles which are not equal rather than a completely rotating movement of NiTi files. Therefore, for these preparation or procedure various files has been evolved. Many disadvantages were reported on using these hand files such as transportation of canal, file breakage along with more time consuming to complete the procedure. Hence, the objective of this review article is to eliminate all these shortcomings by using recent advancements in these file systems. Now because of these root canal treatment has been more secure, convenient, feasible and overall less time taking. This step in advancement is marked as major success to deal root canal procedure. Single File System is a revolutionary approach to root canal preparation. No system is prime or superior otherwise everyone would be using the same system every time. Single file system requires less time for shaping and cleaning of canal as well as they are beneficial as they are able to reach to difficult canals and most apical portion of the root apex.

articleTitle: Unlocking the Potential: The Crucial Role of Data Preprocessing in Big Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Access to the internet can significantly enhance the capabilities and opportunities in the field of data mining. It provides a vast source of data, tools, and resources that can be leveraged to improve the data mining process. The Internet offers access to a wide range of data sources, including social media, websites, online databases, and more. The effectiveness of the data mining process depends on the ability to extract from a large dataset meaningful patterns and models. The goal of data mining is to uncover previously unknown information inside large databases. However, the information in the current datasets is not always unified and clean. Despite extensive work on the part of developers and fine-tuners, data mining models remain highly dependent on the quality of the data they are fed. The focus of this research is on the steps taken before feeding data into a machine-learning system. Any machine learning algorithm's major success is predicated on the caliber of the input data it uses. Even though many aspects influence how well Machine Learning (ML) performs a job, the representation and quality of the instance data remain key components in the algorithm's overall effectiveness. The process of knowledge discovery becomes increasingly challenging during the training phase when there is an abundance of irrelevant and duplicated information, along with noisy and unreliable data. Data preparation and filtering steps in ML problems are well known to cost a substantial amount of processing time. Data preprocessing produces the final training set. Access to data, secure data handling, a robust network infrastructure, and the support of the IT industry are all critical components of successful data mining endeavors. Hence, this article offers strategies for optimizing data collection performance at every stage of data preprocessing.

articleTitle: Effective Information Gathering in a Three-Dimensional Setting Through the Unmanned Aerial Vehicles and Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In order to improve data gathering and monitoring, wireless sensor networks (WSNs) and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have been employed together recently. This strengthens the design of the WSN, where UAVs serve as aerial base stations linking wireless sensors in remote areas of surveillance networks. In order to tackle the clustering problem of the WSN and determine the best site for the UAV to prolong its usable life, this optimization research employs two algorithms: (1) Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and (2) Genetic Algorithm (GA). WSNs can operate in multimedia networks thanks to the mobility, computing power, and battery life of these mobile devices. While offering a comprehensive assessment of nearly all scenarios involving the usage of UAVs and UGVs, this paper focuses mainly on the employment of UAVs for data collecting in WSNs. Drones or unmanned aerial vehicles (UGVs) can collect data from stationary sensor nodes in the monitoring fields. Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can collect data alone or in conjunction with other UAVs. New technology known as unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) has showed promise in raising economic efficiency, enhancing urban intelligence, and enhancing people's quality of life. Due to its applications in a multitude of domains, such as public health, environmental protection, disaster management, security, agriculture, transportation, and communication, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have grown in popularity. Industry 4.0's B5G applications are inspired by intelligent, networked things. Consequently, wherever in the world a large number of things need to collaborate and be monitored in real time, the Internet of Things (IoT) is crucial for making this possible

articleTitle: A Systematic Review on Cotton Plant Disease Detection & Classification Using Machine & Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Crop diseases, which have a negative impact on food supply as well as economic losses, have a significant impact on crop production and quality yields. In most rural areas of India, agriculture is the main profession. Therefore, it is crucial to use cutting-edge and precise computer vision-based algorithms for automatic crop disease identification and categorization so that prompt prophylactic steps may be advised. Numerous computer vision-based strategies have been reviewed in the literature, along with their benefits and drawbacks. These techniques use a variety of machine learning, deep learning, CNN, and image processing methods. In this study, we thoroughly analyzed recent research studies on the identification and categorization of various cotton plant diseases, conducted by a variety of academics and researchers, and summarized them based on crucial factors, such as the deep learning/machine learning algorithm used, the dataset used for experiments, performance matrices, types of disease detected and classified, and the highest accuracy achieved by the model. As per the analysis carried out, Custom CNN technique along with ResNet 50 / GoogLeNet provides maximum accuracy of 98.53%. In general, the average accuracy of deep learning model is quite high as compare to machine learning model.

articleTitle: Machine learning Based Clustering Using Spotify Audio Features
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In this paper, we study the association between different clustering algorithms. Clustering is a crucial technique for data mining applications and research. Spotify audio features were analysed using machine learning techniques that separate the provided data into various clusters according to how close or how far apart they are from one another. Without any prior understanding of the data being considered, clustering analysis offers a helpful technique to group items. This study uses k-means, fuzzy c-means (FCM), and Possibilistic C- means (PCM) algorithms to classify datasets extracted from the Spotify API of random songs into different clusters. The results show that the K-means algorithms outperform fuzzy c-means (FCM) and probabilistic c-means (PCM), using silhouette scores as a performance comparison criterion. Values of silhouette coefficient that performed the best was for K-means (n=6) and is 0.465. Additionally, we observed that K-means performed better when value of n was greater; however, FCM showed a decline in performance as n increased, whereas PCM showed a steady performance across all n clusters. Utilizing clustering algorithms for categorizing songs based on audio data gives insightful analysis and useful applications, which has been increasingly popular in recent years.

articleTitle: System for IoT Agriculture Using LoRaWAN
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has acquired increasing significance in agriculture and food production in recent years, expanding its reach beyond smart city applications. In this comprehensive study, we present a pioneering, exceptionally scalable IoT system specifically tailored for agricultural purposes. This innovative system leverages the Low-Power Wide-Area Network (LoRaWAN) for long-distance, energy-efficient data transmission from sensor nodes to cloud-based services. This IoT solution is underpinned by a highly extensible cloud computing framework that effectively harnesses data streams for in-depth analytics. In the study, we introduce an innovative, highly scalable Internet of Things agricultural system. For long-distance and low-power data transfer from the sensor nodes to the cloud services, this system is built on the LoRaWAn network. Our highly scalable cloud computing solution makes use of data streams for analytics. In this case study, we display some early findings for a grape vineyard.

articleTitle: Value Prediction of Real Estate Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Real estate is property in the form of land and houses. Its prices depend on location, number of bedrooms, society, area, etc. India is second in the world regarding population growth, so affordable housing becomes very necessary. The real estate business is very vast. So, customers or sellers need to know the estimated price of the houses. This research covers that area and predicts housing prices. This work uses k-fold cross-validation and linear regression model. In K-fold cross-validation, the data is divided into k different subsets which are also called fold. A linear regression model is a machine learning model that describes the relations between a dependent variable and one or more independent variables. The data used in this work is for Bangalore state. The results obtained from this linear regression model are compared to real data. The results from this study prove that this model can accurately predict the prices of buildings and houses. Furthermore, this accurate prediction will help customers and sellers, and directly impact the economy.

articleTitle: ChatGPT Tweets Sentiment Analysis Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Nowadays, ChatGPT attracts the attention of people due to its ability to perform various tasks impressively. Recently, ChatGPT has become a very popular tool, and many people are keen to know about its performance as well as responses or opinions about ChatGPT from its users. This paper can determine whether or not people like the ChatGPT tool by learning their opinions about it. In this paper, a dataset has been used that contains 50,000 tweets related to ChatGPT. The main goal is to build, train, test, and deploy a model to predict sentiment from thousands of tweets. In this in-depth sentiment analysis of ChatGPT responses, the polarity of each tweet has been found and labelled either positive or negative. In this, the analysis of the distribution of sentiment in the ChatGPT Kaggle dataset as well as how to prepare the Twitter data to prepare it for sentiment analysis have been studied. After that, the accuracy of different machine learning models has been found out. Find out which one has the highest accuracy as compared to others.

articleTitle: Feature Engineering with Microarray Gene Expression Techniques for Asymptomatic Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The microarray gene expression patterns (MGEP) allow gene microarray technology to classify cancers at a very early stage. Thus, cancer categorization gene expression profile studies can improve Computer Aided Diagnosis (CAD) systems. However, designing the CAD using MGEP is a challenging research problem. This paper presents a systematic analysis of the present solutions for processing MGEP for disease identification. The recent studies mainly worked on complex MGEP data, pre-processing, important feature selection, and classification. State-of-the-arts were explored followed by the investigation of commonly used MGEP feature selection methods using publicly available datasets. This work designs and investigates feature selection approaches such as Fisher score (FS), Relief F (RF), Signal Noise Ratio (SNR), and Information gain (IG). We used Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naive Bayes (NB), and Adaboost classifiers to analyze the results. The outcome of this paper demonstrates the different challenges of existing methods.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Supervised Learning Models for Predicting Heart Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Machine Learning (ML) has the potential ability to predict and draw patterns from the voluminous clinical and convoluted data from the healthcare system. Cardiovascular disease is a serious lethal syndrome that affects the heart and blood vessels. Prediction of heart disease (HD) is one of the most crucial challenges in the domain of medical data analysis. Early prediction of the disease by the identification of risk factors using machine learning algorithms could impede the severity of the disease and save the lives of several individuals. In this research work, we have investigated different supervised learning models which perform effective roles in predicting cardiovascular disease. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) has been utilized to reduce the features to improve the effectiveness of the learning process. Prediction of heart disease is attained by implementing the concepts of supervised machine learning (SML) algorithms such as Gradient Boosting (GB), Naive Bayes (NB), K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN), Random Forest (RF) and Decision Tree (DT) methods. The models are examined and evaluated by various metrics like Precision, Recall, Area Under Curve (AUC), Accuracy, and F1-score. The RF model outperforms the others when the models are evaluated, with an accuracy of 86.81 % for data set DS1 and 99.02% for data set DS2.

articleTitle: Advance QR Code-Based Attendance Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In this day and age technology is growing very fast and becoming a crucial part of our life and due to this advancement in the technology. There is a need to replace the traditional attendance-taking system with the advance one in the college and universities to save both time and effort. Knowing that smartphones are also becoming an integral part of student life nowadays, so as to speed up the process of attendance taken by professors in the college and save lecturing time, and increase productivity. In this paper, a QR code-based attendance system is developed. The Qr code is displayed by every teacher at the beginning or end of the lecture and students have to scan the Qr code through their mobile application to mark their presence in the lecture. The material here discusses the way the system functions in detail.

articleTitle: Microcontroller Based Water Treatment Scheme for Fish Farming
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This paper presents an extensive review of the application and benefits of micro controller-driven water treatment systems in the field of aquaculture. The focus is on key parameters that are critical to successful fish farming, such as water turbidity, pH balance, and temperature. These parameters not only affect the health and growth of the fish but also the overall productivity of the farm. By leveraging the capabilities of the Global System for Mobile Communications (GSM) network, the proposed system integrates sensors that continuously monitor these parameters and a GSM module that facilitates real-time data transmission to an online platform. This innovative approach allows farmers to access the data remotely, ensuring constant supervision of water conditions and enabling prompt intervention when the parameters deviate from the ideal. The system further aids in enhancing precision, reliability, and overall fish health and growth by striving to maintain optimal conditions at all times. Additionally, this review highlights the potential of such technology to transform traditional farming practices, making them more efficient and environmentally sustainable. The integration of such technology into everyday farming operations can contribute significantly to the industry's growth and profitability.

articleTitle: A Fine-Tuned ResNet50 Model for Multiclass Cancer Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Cancer has maintained its position as a leading contributor to mortality across the world. To enhance treatment outcomes and elevate cancer survival rates, which exert significant economic and social repercussions, the development of a precise and early cancer prediction model is required. Equally important is a comprehensive grasp of the biological pathways underpinning cancer development. Over the past two decades, the categorization of diverse cancer types has undergone exploration through both machine learning and deep learning techniques. At the forefront of these efforts, molecular-level diagnostics utilizing microarray technology have the potential to provide accurate, unbiased, and methodical cancer classification. Given that the expression patterns across the entire genome are shaped by thousands of genes, the selective identification of pertinent genes becomes crucial for precise cancer diagnostics, given that not all genes are implicated in cancer processes. In this work, a deep learning-based pre-trained ResNet50 model has been utilized for the prediction of multiple types of cancer. The model has been fine-tuned by varying the number of epochs, optimizers and learning rates. This model has achieved an accuracy of 99% at epoch 50 which is higher in comparison to the existing models.

articleTitle: A Decade of AI and Animation Convergence: A Bibliometric Analysis of Contributions
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In the past ten years, there has been significant growth and innovation at the intersection of artificial intelligence (AI) and animation. This convergence has resulted in transformative advancements with far-reaching interdisciplinary implications. To gain a comprehensive understanding of this rapidly evolving field, this essay presents a meticulous bibliometric analysis that explores the extensive body of research contributions, collaborations, and emerging trends. By employing rigorous bibliometric techniques, this study provides an encompassing overview of how research in artificial intelligence and animation has evolved over time. It reveals invaluable insights into the profound impact generated by their synergistic relationship. Moreover, it identifies key contributors as well as prominent institutions and countries involved in fostering interdisciplinary collaboration to facilitate convergence. Through a detailed examination of publication patterns, temporal dynamics within research topics are illuminated. This sheds light on emerging areas for further investigation while also providing a roadmap for future research endeavors. Such findings not only enhance our comprehension of the mutually beneficial association between AI and animation but also equip stakeholders with strategic insights necessary for resource allocation and decision-making within this swiftly changing landscape driven by AI-infused innovation. Ultimately, these analyses underscore the pivotal role played by contributions from researchers across various disciplines in shaping the ever-evolving realm where AI intersects with animation.

articleTitle: Enhancing Virtual Machine Migration in Cloud Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Virtual Machine Migration (VMM) is a crucial aspect of cloud computing that allow organizations to efficiently manage their computing resources. However, this process presents several challenges, including resource contention, network bandwidth limitation, and compatibility issues which can lead to increased migration time, service disruption, and even data loss. To address these challenges, this research paper recapitulates VM Migration Techniques, objectives, its issues. In this study a model is proposed that has the potential to minimize the downtime and the other issues associated with VM migration process in cloud computing. The proposed model employs machine learning technique to estimate how much compute and network traffic a virtual machine will require when relocated from one real machine to another. The model is then trained with an appropriate machine learning technique to predict the required processing power, network bandwidth, and computing resources during the migration, which aids in maintaining VM downtime to a minimum. It enhances the VMM procedure and guarantees the virtual machine runs well on the new hardware.

articleTitle: Unveiling Intractable Epileptogenic Brain Networks with Deep Learning Algorithms: A Novel and Comprehensive Framework for Scalable Seizure Prediction with Unimodal Neuroimaging Data in Pediatric Patients
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Epilepsy is a prevalent neurological disorder affecting approximately 50 million individuals worldwide and 1.2 million Americans. There exist millions of pediatric patients with intractable epilepsy, a condition in which seizures fail to come under control. The occurrence of seizures can result in physical injury, disorientation, and unconsciousness. Predicting seizures can help parents and healthcare providers take precautions, and prevent risky situations. This research proposes a novel framework to predict seizures in pediatric patients by evaluating machine learning algorithms. Various machine learning algorithms' performance is evaluated on important metrics such as accuracy, precision, specificity, sensitivity, F1 score and Matthew's Correlation Coefficient (MCC). The results show that the deep learning algorithms are more successful in predicting seizures than logistic Regression, and k nearest neighbors. This research has significant implications for healthcare providers in proactively managing seizure occurrence in pediatric patients, potentially transforming clinical practices, and improving pediatric care.

articleTitle: Advancing Education and Cultural Heritage Through Innovative AI Techniques: A Bibliometric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: AI powered educational tools have the potential to transform teaching methods and create adaptable learning experiences. These tools can analyze student data, automate administrative tasks. Contribute to making education more inclusive and engaging. Moreover AI technologies can significantly impact the preservation and promotion of heritage. They offer solutions, for documentation, analysis and sharing by facilitating digitization cataloging, virtual simulations and interpretation of texts. To gain insights into the intersection of AI, education and cultural heritage a bibliometric analysis was conducted. This analysis examined trends in research related to AI techniques for cultural heritage outreach. The dataset revealed an increase in publications within this field with an annual growth rate of 7.34%. The documents analyzed were relatively recent with an age of 4.11 years indicating advancements in this domain. Impressively each document received an average of 5.328 citations reflecting their impact on the field. Furthermore the analysis highlighted variations in citation counts across years. While some years had no citations all others witnessed higher recognition and influence in terms of scholarly output. Notably the year 2020 emerged as influential for research output within this subject area. The main objectives of this study is to identify research areas within AI education and cultural heritage outreach well as recognize most influential countries and gaps in the area. It offers information, about the condition of research areas where further investigation is needed and new developments that can inform stakeholders about research collaborations, allocation of resources and policy formulation.

articleTitle: The Role of Virtual Reality in Education: A Comprehensive Review of Research and Application
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This paper provides a detailed analysis of the studies on VR applications in the realm of education. In this paper the last 8 years of data has been analyzed through bibliography research method, which depicts that the use of Virtual Reality (VR) in education has been significantly increased and the results show the growth of students in their academic key areas. This paper demonstrates the positive and negative effects of VR on user's health and how VR technology is being used in the education field and how students can improve their learning abilities. VR has potential to transform traditional education methods to the next level and can be an additional tool to improve the teaching methodology.

articleTitle: A Research Study of Heart Health Monitoring Using Deep Learning and IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) pose a substantial worldwide health burden, hence requiring sophisticated strategies for their prevention and treatment. This research study presents a novel framework that combines deep learning algorithms and IoT devices to enable ongoing monitoring of heart health by means of heartbeat categorization. The objective of this project is to create a highly accurate and effective system that can classify different cardiac diseases based on real-time electrocardiogram (ECG) signals. This study makes a scholarly contribution by utilizing the capabilities of deep learning and the IoT to improve the timely identification and proactive treatment of cardiovascular conditions. As a result, patient care and overall health outcomes are enhanced. The paper presents a thorough technique that includes many stages such as data collecting, preprocessing, building of a deep learning model, integration of IoT, and evaluation of performance. The expected results include the development of a comprehensive categorization system, the integration of Internet of Things (IoT) technology for continuous monitoring, and a comparative analysis demonstrating the advantages of the system in comparison to current methodologies. In this undertaking, our aim is to achieve significant advancements in the field of cardiac health monitoring and disease identification, hence promoting enhanced healthcare methodologies and patient results.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Approach for Early Detection and Prediction of Chronic Diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: It is essential to identify and predict certain diseases early on in order to stop them from progressing. However, doctors frequently make mistakes when performing manual diagnoses. In order to successfully detect and predict prevalent chronic illnesses, this paper makes use of cutting-edge machine learning algorithms. The proposed system ensures accurate categorization of people with chronic diseases using CNN-style algorithms to automatically extract features and forecast disease as well as KNN for distance calculation and dataset matching. To enable a widespread disease forecast using the patient's symptoms, the system contains a complete dataset that includes disease symptoms, lifestyle characteristics, and specifics of doctor consultations. The proposed system as the hybrid of CNN and KNN performs better as compared to other various algorithms, including NB, DT, and LR, are also compared in this research.

articleTitle: Navigating the Nexus: Exploring the Fusion of AI and Nanotechnology for Cutting-Edge Advances
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The convergence of artificial intelligence (AI) and nanotechnology has initiated a transformative journey, introducing innovative possibilities across various fields. This review article explores the dynamic interaction between these two disciplines, emphasizing their collaborative potential, notable accomplishments, and prevailing challenges. The integration of AI algorithms with nanotechnology has expedited material discovery, nanoscale characterization, personalized medical applications, and nano- electronics. AI's predictive capabilities have revolutionized the discovery of novel nanomaterials with customized properties, the enhancement of drug delivery systems, and the design of intricate nano-electronic components. However, this synergy is accompanied by challenges such as data quality, multidisciplinary cooperation, ethical considerations, and computational complexity. The fusion of AI and nanotechnology is poised to transform industries, unlock quantum advancements, and influence sustainable materials. As AI's capacities evolve, scholars are prepared to address challenges and harness the transformative potential of AI- nanotechnology integration.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis Using NLP & Deep Learning on Social Media Tweets
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: A form of natural language processing (NLP) method that determines the positivity, negativity, or neutrality of data. Frequently, sentiment assessment is carried out on written information. The present research seeks to conduct sentiment analysis upon social media messages through NLP (natural language processing) along with advanced learning methods. The objective is to correctly categories tweets to be either beneficial or detrimental according to the tone of the content. The study employs methodologies for preprocessing that include tokenization, stop-word elimination, along with stemming to analyse a dataset comprised of tweets collected from different social networks. The previously prepared information will be utilized to train a model determined by deep learning, and specifically the Random Forest or Supporting raster machine-based algorithm and LSTM, to categories tweets through sentiment classifications. The efficiency of the framework will be assessed employing metrics that include precision, recall, and accuracy. This project's outcomes could possess significant consequences for companies and organizations that depend on social networking sites for advertising and managing their brands. By analysing the sentiment about tweets about their goods or services, businesses can obtain valuable insights into their customers' opinions as well as preferences, that may influence their advertising tactics and increase customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: A CNN-Based Framework for Detection and Recognition of Objects Using Transfer Learning: A Case Study on Flower Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The vast variety of floral species present on Earth poses a considerable challenge in memorizing their individual names. Acquiring knowledge about specific flower types inhabiting diverse environments like forests, mountains, and dense regions becomes crucial for their recognition and differentiation. Consequently, the development of a technique for accurately determining flower categories becomes imperative. The task of distinguishing and categorizing a particular blossom amidst the extensive array of floral species presents a formidable task. Hence, the automation of flower species identification has been a subject of extensive research interest. This research domain is characterized by the utilization of features extracted from floral images in conjunction with specialized algorithms aimed at classifying flower species. A prominent aspect of these endeavors is the employment of three widely recognized flower image datasets. The present study constitutes a comprehensive survey of various methodologies proposed by diverse researchers with the objective of accomplishing precise identification of flower species.

articleTitle: Wave Propagation Models for 5G Base Station Applications to Reduce Mutual Coupling in DualPolarized MIMO Antennas
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In this research, we look at how the location of base station antennas is affected by various wave propagation models and network architectures. With dual polarization antennas covering the sub 6 GHz range, Multiple input Multiple output (MIMO) combinations are being explored for practical deployment. Propagation models throughout the investigated terrain are examined in relation to modulation techniques, data rates, and throughput. A huge MIMO antenna array of 88 elements is used to achieve the necessary 5G data rate. The probabilistic evaluation of a dual band microstrip patch antenna is also provided, which is capable of transmitting and receiving at both 4G and 5G frequencies. The gain of the proposed dual-band patch antenna is expected to increase thanks to the use of randomization based on meta materials. The effectiveness of the proposed MIMO antenna is evaluated in terms of its impedance bandwidth, maximum gain, a state of isolation mutual coupling, among other metrics.

articleTitle: A Novel DenseSIFT U-NET Based Approach to Perform Kidney Tumor Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Kidney tumors pose a significant health concern, particularly in senior age groups, and are a leading cause of morbidity and mortality. Current clinical practices rely on noninvasive methods, such as Computed Tomography (CT), Ultrasound (US), Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), for the identification and diagnosis of kidney tumors. In this research paper, we introduce a novel DenseSIFT integrated U-Net based network for end-to-end kidney and kidney tumor segmentation. The proposed architecture employs DenseSIFT image as an input to the encoder-decoder structure, where the encoder and decoder are interconnected by skip connections and learns robust features to enable accurate segmentation. To validate the effectiveness of our approach, we also conduct performance comparisons with the traditional Vanilla U-Net. The experimental results on the 2019 Kidney and Kidney Tumor Segmentation (KiTS19) challenge dataset demonstrate that our method achieves an impressive mean Intersection over Union (meanIoU) of 91.98%, showcasing its potential for enhanced kidney tumor segmentation.

articleTitle: Improvements in Satellite Navigation, Artificial Intelligence, as well as Deep Learning for Recognition, Prediction and Evaluation of Ocean Oil Spillages
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Essentially improvements in satellite imagery have helped make it easier to swiftly record and identify the place of origin and extent of crude oil leaks in lakes and rivers, the existence of additional natural components possessing comparable appearances impedes immediate recognition as well as swift choices over disaster mitigation. At this point, a variety of techniques are being used without varying degrees of efficacy to tell spills of petroleum apart from their imitators. Furthermore, it is difficult to correctly predict the direction for spilled petroleum products. Observations suggest that infrared as well as electromagnetic aerial and orbiting communication devices are employed in tracking spills of petroleum, although microwave detection technologies becoming utilized more often because of their capacity to function regardless of conditions. It is critical to continue investigations into the discipline with the objective to boost present equipment as well as create specialized detectors for precise spillage identification and improved categorization, utilizing resulting geographic information artificial intelligence campaigns. However, the new technology has permitted the application of artificial intelligence as well as deep learning simulations, that appear more announcing compared to statistics. The primary artificial intelligence methods for detecting oil spills were a Support Vector Machine as well as albeit performance is limited by machine learning algorithms constraint to direct categorization of images sans provision within a from beginning to end adaptable environment. By the opposite together, the reliable extraction of characteristics of deep neural networks algorithms plus their abilities for self-training increase the efficiency of classification of these algorithms

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithms for Classifying Disorder in Brain and Lung Biomedical Images
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Biomedical imaging and its research guide tremendous impact on the medical field. Different types of biomedical imaging help doctors to diagnose and detect diseases in advance. The early diagnosis increases the life span of humans. The machine learning algorithms are incorporated with the biomedical images to make the Computer-Aided Diagnosis (CAD) system. The CAD will reduce the human efforts and the false negatives of the diagnosis. Any damage that happens to the cells is known as abnormality. The abnormalities can be found with the help of computer-aided systems. Brain tumor classification is a complex problem due to the size, shape, and intensity variation, the dataset consists of glioma, meningioma, and pituitary tumor images. The features from the deep architecture and wavelet scattering methods are explored for brain tumor classification. These features are classified by using a Support Vector Machine with a cubic kernel. The proposed method shows a promising accuracy while considering the state-of-the-art methods

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare with Special Consideration in Radio Imaging
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a transformational technology that involves the usage of Machine Learning (ML) & computerized algorithms, to solve the complicated data of imaging technology. Computer-aided diagnostics have great accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity in detecting radiographic abnormalities. Diagnostic radiology plays a pivotal role in modern healthcare, enabling the accurate detection and diagnosis of various diseases and conditions. In recent years, AI has emerged as a powerful tool in the field of diagnostic radiology, offering the potential to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and patient outcomes. This article examines the applications, benefits, and prospects of AI in radiology diagnosis. After the evolution of artificial intelligence and machine learning, it has become easy for radiologists to detect diseases and plan their treatment. Here in this article, we focused on how artificial intelligence is applicable in the department of radio diagnosis.

articleTitle: A Smote-Based Churn Prediction System Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 1st DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education and Industry 4.0 (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Customer churn is the occurrence in which consumers stop utilizing a company's products or services. It is critical for businesses since it has a direct influence on revenue and long-term viability. Customer churn detection is crucial in the telecommunications industry, as it helps maintain existing customers by identifying factors like competitor offers and network faults. This loss significantly impacts customer lifetime value, future revenue, and service length. Companies use predictive models to forecast client attrition, reducing the industry's profitability. This paper proposes the use of machine learning to anticipate customer turnover in the telecom industry. It involves exploring datasets, dealing with missing data, and producing new features. Features are chosen and categorical variables are encoded. A pipeline employing SMOTE and RandomUnder Sampler is used to address the issue of unbalanced classes.
